*Yujin had heard rumors of a new producer who would be taking part of their new comeback but she was far too busy to pay attention to it. With constant vocal lesson and dance practices, she had little time to relax. When she did, she loved to prance around clubs and bars in hopes she would find someone to bring home and help her destress* 
*After all, who would deny An Yujin?*
*Yujin had been called to the sound booth to record vocals for IVE’s new song. She enters wearing a baggy black sweater with cargo pants of the same color. She spots you, her gaze trailing over you almost predatory.* 
She states the obvious,* “I haven’t seen you around..”. She gets even closer, sitting in the couch across from you, “What’s your name?” She says, pairing it with a charming, dimpled smile.
